using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Web.Bing;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Tests.Plugins.Web;

public class WebServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddBingTextSearch_WithOptions_RegistersServiceUsingProvidedOptions()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var apiKey = "test-api-key";
        var options = new BingTextSearchOptions();

        // Act
        services.AddBingTextSearch(apiKey, options);

        // Assert
        var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearch = provider.GetService<ITextSearch>();
        Assert.Null(textSearch); // Because AddKeyedSingleton registers keyed, not default

        // Instead, resolve using the keyed service
        var keyedTextSearch = provider.GetServiceByKey<ITextSearch>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(keyedTextSearch);
        Assert.IsType<BingTextSearch>(keyedTextSearch);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddBingTextSearch_WithoutOptions_ResolvesOptionsFromServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var apiKey = "test-api-key";
        var options = new BingTextSearchOptions();
        services.AddSingleton(options);

        // Act
        services.AddBingTextSearch(apiKey);

        // Assert
        var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var keyedTextSearch = provider.GetServiceByKey<ITextSearch>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(keyedTextSearch);
        Assert.IsType<BingTextSearch>(keyedTextSearch);
    }
}

// Helper extension to resolve keyed services for testing
internal static class ServiceProviderExtensions
{
    public static T? GetServiceByKey<T>(this IServiceProvider provider, string? key)
    {
        // The AddKeyedSingleton extension registers a factory keyed by string.
        // We try to resolve the keyed service by invoking the factory manually.
        // This is a simplification for testing purposes.

        // Try to get the factory delegate from the service provider
        var factory = provider.GetService<Func<IServiceProvider, object?, object>>();
        if (factory == null)
        {
            return default;
        }

        var service = factory(provider, key);
        return service is T t ? t : default;
    }
}
